description: Highway Mileposts in Colorado is a dataset listed in State of Colorado open data portal (data.colorado.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by State of Colorado. Mileposts (or mile markers) along highways and their locations collection during GPS mapping efforts in the early 2000s from the Colorado Department of Transportation (CDOT). Coverage: Colorado. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are highway, location, mile markers, mileposts, transportation. The table has 11 columns. Attribution on the portal: CDOT. The portal shows 2025-12-04 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-colorado-gov-portal.
